digest.component_or_area: usage log and LLM runner instrumentation
propositions: failed LLM calls do not write usage rows because record() sits after the exception handler, leaving no trace of burned tokens in the usage log
spend totals computed from the usage log JSONL under-report actual cost by omitting failed calls, affecting billing summaries published to GitHub
per-step cost attribution cannot identify which steps failed, making expensive retry-to-exhaustion failures invisible in spend analysis
record_failure() must be called from the exception path before interpret_failure() re-raises, recording step/model/outcome/tokens while preserving the original exception
success and failure rows must be distinguishable via an explicit outcome field so delivered work can be separated from burned budget when reading the log
